task_message:
Case F09: segment the fibrous soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 261x261x131 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case F09 complete. Summary of what I did:

1. **Explored** the volume with contact sheets in all three planes — found a large heterogeneous mass in the thigh, spanning roughly axial 20–110, larger than the femur's medial border, with a bright core and a dark lobulated rim.
2. **Initial point prompt** leaked into the anterior muscle (178 mL wrong region) — undid it.
3. **Lasso prompt** on the axial slice through the mass's widest part, using edge marks around its outer boundary, produced a clean 162.6 mL mask with 1 connected component.
4. **Verified** the mask at all six extremities (axial 12/20/110, coronal 72/105/152/160, sagittal 140/172/180/200) — no lesion tissue visible beyond the mask at any end; the thin tails matched genuine fascial extensions.
5. **Rejected** all three automatic candidates (C1–C3), which were limb-sized regions of normal muscle/fat, not lesion.
6. **Saved** the mask (v2) with medium confidence — the boundary tracks the fibrous mass in all three planes, though the bright peripheral fringe at the inferior margin was intensity-ambiguous (fat vs. part of the lesion).
